goal_on: Activate the unchanged business task through thread/goal/set. Native Codex supplies goal tools, goal context and automatic continuation. No controller reminder or custom protocol.
matched_inputs: One archive instance and deadline per scenario, identical tools and business documents, fresh job IDs and workstations. Compare prepared inputs after logical-actor normalization.
primary_endpoint: Four connected authored communicators, at least two distinct source-linked reply authors and a request/read/reply/requester-readback during overlapping lifetimes.
budget: Existing 3600-second actor and 4500-second rollout limits; no added goal token budget.
review: Full public native inputs, responses, tools and finals; deterministic source/readback reconstruction; actual native goal lifecycle and continuation review.
evidence_limits: One observation per cell; identical fixtures do not control inference randomness, routing or runtime load. Goal status is not formation. Prior off observations are not matched controls.

offline_validation.native_continuation: Verified with the installed Codex binary and a local scripted endpoint; zero hosted model calls.
offline_validation.common_suite_reuse: Exact source, harness and sealed original suite verified before reuse; each preparation reruns its own business controls.
